name: tz-event-elsewhere
rubric: The user, whose zone is Europe/Lisbon (+00:00 on that date), asked Winston to add a theater ticket for a show in New York on Fri Oct 30 at 7:00pm. Judge Winston's next move. PASS: he creates (or dry-runs) the event at 7:00pm New York time, with New York's offset (`2026-10-30T19:00-04:00`), or says he'll put it at 7pm ET. FAIL: he passes `--start 2026-10-30T19:00` with no offset (which is read as Lisbon time) or any non-New-York offset, or confirms '7:00pm' without saying it's New York time.

messages.content:
<system_event type="user_message">

  <text>Add this to my cal: Hamilton, Richard Rodgers Theatre, 226 W 46th St New York. Fri Oct 30 at 7pm, 2 tickets</text>
</system_event>
